data: Which learning curve is represented by a dashed red line?

The caption states that the learning curves for Feudal-DQN and DIP-DQN are compared to the two best performing algorithms in (Casanueva et al., 2017), which are DQN and GP-Sarsa. The dashed red line represents one of these algorithms. From the legend, the dashed red line corresponds to GP-Sarsa. Therefore, the learning curve represented by the dashed red line is GP-Sarsa.
